user.title: PUN price source
user.description: Where to read the PUN Index GME. The GME website download needs no credentials but is not a documented interface. The official GME API needs credentials, requested from GME (free for personal use); if it fails, the prices come from the website. You can change the source later with Reconfigure.

credentials.title: GME API credentials
credentials.description: User and password sent by GME after the registration at api.mercatoelettrico.org.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: Energy sensor of the grid meter and the contract in YAML. See the contract guide in the documentation. {error}

reauth_confirm.title: GME API credentials
reauth_confirm.description: GME rejected the credentials: enter them again. Until then the prices come from the GME website.

reconfigure.title: PUN price source
reconfigure.description: Switch between the GME website download and the official GME API, for example when the GME credentials arrive.

reconfigure_credentials.title: GME API credentials
reconfigure_credentials.description: User and password sent by GME after the registration at api.mercatoelettrico.org.

error.invalid_auth: GME rejected the username or password.

init.title: Contract
init.description: Energy sensor and contract in YAML. Interval contracts keep the costs already counted this month; monthly contracts recompute the month. {error}

options.api: Official GME API (credentials; falls back to the website)

choose_entry.message: Choose the PUN Tariff entry with config_entry_id.

calculate_bill.name: Calculate a bill
calculate_bill.description: Bill of a month from its kWh by band, with the configured contract and the PUN of that month. Use it to check the contract against an invoice. Interval contracts are approximated with the band averages.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: PUN Tariff entry (needed only if there are several).

kwh_f1.name: kWh F1
kwh_f1.description: kWh in band F1 (all kWh here for single-band invoices).

expected_total.name: Invoice total
expected_total.description: Total of the invoice without the TV fee, to get the difference.
